data.one_liner: A package for adding multi window support to Flutter on Desktop.
data.what_it_does: Allows creating, closing, and managing multiple application windows on supported desktop platforms. Provides IPC (inter-process communication) and event streams between different windows.
use_when: You are building a Flutter desktop application for macOS or Linux that requires multiple windows.
You need to communicate and pass data between different desktop windows.
avoid_when: You need Windows support, as it is currently not implemented.
You are targeting mobile or web platforms.
strengths: Enables multi-window architectures on desktop platforms
Supports window-to-window communication and event streams
API to control window lifecycle (create, close, title, count)
weaknesses: Experimental package under heavy development with no API stability guarantees
Requires manual native Swift setup on macOS
data.setup_notes: Requires initializing MultiWindow in main.dart and adding manual Swift integration code in macos/runner/MainFlutterWindow.swift.
